bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money from the clean water fund to acquire land in Cottonwood County.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; RED ROCK RURAL WATER SYSTEM.

$3,900,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the clean water fund to the Board of Water and Soil Resources for a grant to the Red Rock Rural Water System to acquire land containing a groundwater aquifer so that the system can continue to provide safe, high-quality water services to its community.
